evidence: Uses the vendor-neutral IndexNow endpoint rather than a single proprietary submission path.
Reads canonical production sitemap URLs directly, so notifications cannot diverge from deployed pages.
The key is a non-secret ownership token stored at the required public location.
No credentials, private data, unpublished pages, or third-party tracking scripts are introduced.
Only approved homepage, workflow, and download URLs are eligible for notification.
The command records actual HTTP status and does not claim indexing placement.

conditions: Key file must be live on the production origin before submission.
Run only after GitHub Pages reports success.
Record only the real IndexNow HTTP response.
